patch_description: Restructure the solver into a clean pipeline over barycentric coordinates (guaranteeing feasibility by construction instead of post-hoc projection): (1) diverse deterministic + seeded starts, (2) staged softmin SLSQP with vectorized analytic gradients, (3) targeted worst-triplet refinement — a discrete polish that moves only points of the argmin triplet, with perpendicular escape directions away from the constraining line, batched and vectorized, (4) global teleport restarts from the hot set. Barycentric parameterization removes constraint handling from the optimizer (only box bounds remain) and makes every intermediate point feasible, so the polish accepts candidates that the old clipped-xy version rejected. The worst-triplet polish directly attacks the primary objective (the exact discrete min), which softmin only approximates.
